Metamagic Rods | Other Rods
Rod of Metamagic, Intensified
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 189, Advanced Player's Guide pg. 294
Aura strong (no school) CL 17th
Slot none; Price 3,000 gp (lesser), 11,000 gp (normal), 24,500 gp (greater); Weight 5 lbs.
Description
The wielder can cast up to three spells per day that are intensified as though using the Intensified Spell feat (Advanced Player’s Guide).
Construction
Requirements Craft Rod, Intensified Spell; Cost 1,500 gp (lesser), 5,500 gp (normal), 12,250 gp (greater)
